frame.question: Why is my profit down this week?

causes.title: A supplier raised the unit cost of a product

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-COALESCE(SUM(q.qty * (c.final_cost - c.base_cost)), 0), 2) AS effect_ngn
FROM (SELECT product_id,
             AVG(CASE WHEN invoice_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN unit_cost_ngn END) AS final_cost,
             AVG(CASE WHEN invoice_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN unit_cost_ngn END) AS base_cost
      FROM becuz.supplier_invoices GROUP BY product_id) c
JOIN (SELECT l.product_id, SUM(l.qty) AS qty FROM becuz.sale_lines l
      JOIN becuz.sales s ON s.sale_id = l.sale_id
      WHERE CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' GROUP BY l.product_id) q ON q.product_id = c.product_id
WHERE c.final_cost > c.base_cost
evidence.summary: A supplier raised the unit cost of a product: -46,992

check.note: The re-check matched: 46,992 naira from 1 records.

falsified_by.test: unit costs on this week's invoices match the baseline weeks

causes.title: Fewer items sold than in a usual week

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM((COALESCE(f.qty, 0) - COALESCE(b.qty, 0) / 4) * (p.list_price_ngn - c.base_cost)), 2)
       AS effect_ngn
FROM becuz.products p
JOIN (SELECT product_id, AVG(unit_cost_ngn) AS base_cost FROM becuz.supplier_invoices
      WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-10-11' GROUP BY product_id) c ON c.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.product_id, SUM(l.qty) AS qty FROM becuz.sale_lines l JOIN becuz.sales s ON s.sale_id = l.sale_id
           WHERE CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' GROUP BY l.product_id) f ON f.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.product_id, SUM(l.qty) AS qty FROM becuz.sale_lines l JOIN becuz.sales s ON s.sale_id = l.sale_id
           WHERE CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-10-11' GROUP BY l.product_id) b ON b.product_id = p.product_id
evidence.summary: Fewer items sold than in a usual week: -38,611

check.note: The re-check matched: 38,611 naira from 26 records.

falsified_by.test: this week's units sold are at or above a usual week

causes.title: More stock expired or was damaged than usual

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(moved_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN qty * unit_cost_ngn END), 0)
                  - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(moved_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN qty * unit_cost_ngn END), 0) / 4), 2)
       AS effect_ngn
FROM becuz.stock_movements WHERE type IN ('expired', 'damaged')
evidence.summary: More stock expired or was damaged than usual: -35,948

check.note: The re-check matched: 35,948 naira from 29 records.

falsified_by.test: this week's expired and damaged stock is no higher than a usual week

causes.title: Transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-COALESCE(SUM(net_ngn), 0), 2) AS effect_ngn FROM becuz.transfer_check
WHERE bank_txn_id IS NULL AND CAST(sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
evidence.summary: Transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank: -28,360

check.note: The re-check matched: 28,360 naira from 6 records.

falsified_by.test: every transfer sale this week has a matching bank credit

causes.title: A discount kept running after the promo ended

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-COALESCE(SUM(l.discount_ngn), 0), 2) AS effect_ngn
FROM becuz.sale_lines l JOIN becuz.sales s ON s.sale_id = l.sale_id
JOIN becuz.promos p ON p.promo_id = l.promo_id
WHERE CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' AND CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) > p.end_date
evidence.summary: A discount kept running after the promo ended: -20,475

check.note: The re-check matched: 20,475 naira from 19 records.

falsified_by.test: no promo discount was given after the promo's end date

ruled_out.hypothesis: The POS terminal charged a higher fee
ruled_out.reason: The records show no loss from this cause this week.

summary.what_happened: Profit this week was 213,357 against a usual week of 379,412, down 166,055.
why: A supplier raised the unit cost of a product: -46,992
Fewer items sold than in a usual week: -38,611
More stock expired or was damaged than usual: -35,948
Transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank: -28,360
A discount kept running after the promo ended: -20,475

what_to_do.action: Compare prices from other suppliers for the affected product and review its shelf price.
Check stock levels and opening hours for the products that sold less.
Order perishables in smaller batches and check storage for the affected items.
Check these transfers against the bank app with the staff who recorded them.
Switch off the expired promo at the till and check which staff applied it.

owner_questions.question: 6 transfer sales have no matching bank credit (SL-03043, SL-03067, SL-03102, SL-03112, SL-03132, SL-03192). Can you check them with the staff who recorded them?

limitations: Findings show correlation, not proven causation.
The report wording comes from fixed templates; every number comes from SQL.
